summary: Implementation plan covering all 7 owner-requested changes: hiding credit card previews in the list view until clicked, rendering realistic card face designs in the detail modal, adding a Checking filter in the Banks tab, rewording 'stall' to 'time penalty' in Badge Battle, locking the Badge Battle upfront until 70% of module lessons are completed, replacing exam-like Correct/Incorrect labels with a green screen border glow and submit-button confetti, and switching module/card text to smaller regular-weight typography.
